verdict.rationale: Jira's own docs describe Rovo-assisted custom automations, 'from automated reminders to rules that move work forward', and automation that connects tools to workflows. Automated reminders imply time-based triggers, but the evidence never explicitly mentions recurring schedules. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduled or recurring triggers (e.g., cron-style intervals), details of schedule configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled jobs.
